start_kernel: start a new Jupyter kernel by name and return its kernel ID
execute_code: execute Python code in a Jupyter kernel and collect text output and data items
list_kernels: list all running Jupyter kernels on the gateway server
interrupt_kernel: interrupt a running Jupyter kernel by its kernel ID
use_kernel_context_manager: use JupyterKernelClient as a context manager to auto-connect and auto-close the WebSocket
